evidence.reason: `report_problems` is a validator that is supposed to accumulate problems, but it dereferences `report` and `image` as mappings without an `isinstance(..., dict)` guard. A top-level JSON array makes `report.get` at line 347 raise `AttributeError`; a nonempty list-valued `image` makes `image.get` at line 350 raise the same. The function already type-checks other nested values (e.g. `provenance`, line 323), and it has a `schema_version must be ...` problem path, so malformed reports are intended to be reported, not to crash. An uncaught exception also conflicts with the machine-mode I1 error-artifact/stderr behavior. The smallest fix is to validate the report and image containers before field access and append a problem instead.
